historical_reply_visible_addendum.exact_text: ADDENDUM (PR-05, 2026-09-29 ~00:08 CDT; content-free): Reply-visible effects, with no new fields and no wire-shape change. The packet's coverage structure gaps:[{facet,reason}] is unchanged. (1) Relation-table rows are returned to agents that AM-5 authorizes. (2) On schema-39 frames, a caller without source.read that queries a relation table gets the gap {facet: relation_tables, reason: source_read_required}. That replaces {relation_tables, source_raw_read_required}, which remains only for frames produced by a schema-38 database. (3) An authorized agent whose query references relation_events, relation_event_evidence or relation_pairs gets the gap {facet: relation_history, reason: owner_only}, and those tables return no rows to it. The internal frame field relation_read_mode (owner|agent) is sealed in the population record and never appears in a reply. Counts of withheld records or relations are never disclosed.

Use the existing PR-03 closure, including endpoints, basis beads/versions/statements, every evidence event, lifecycle evidence, corrections, replacements and beads/units underlying root status. The source.read-on-the-same-event substitution does not waive any other check. Authorization includes dependencies whose rows are owner-only.

reconciliation.fresh_and_saved_results: An unreadable closure member withholds the entire relation from every agent-visible relation table. A fresh query remains available over its other authorized rows; it reveals no relation-specific gap, count, type pin or history for the withheld relation. This is scoped visibility, never evidence that no relation exists. Re-disclosure of a saved result after any required closure authority lapses is unavailable.
reconciliation.gap_precedence: For schema-39 callers outside AM-5 and without raw authority, source_raw_read_required remains the relation-table gap even if source.read is also absent. Observation-table gaps retain their own existing rules. A paired agent with some unreadable relation dependencies receives no relation-specific gap/count for those withheld families. Generic capability gaps never certify completeness or absence.
reconciliation.grading_and_missing_capabilities: Required, optional and forbidden evidence, authorized populations, temporal/lifecycle and coverage expectations, denominators, metrics, thresholds, safety gates, exclusions and rerun rules remain unchanged. Unsupported required operations or missing required evidence fail unmet obligations and remain accounted. Owner-only history/inspection is not newly excluded or counted as passed. Existing explicit deferrals remain as frozen. No hidden case membership or expectation is disclosed.
reconciliation.grading_scope: Apply unchanged preregistered required/optional/forbidden evidence and status obligations to the clarified authorized population and observed outputs. A truthful gap or narrowed disclosure is not automatic success for a required retrieval. No frozen principal, population, question, gold, expected outcome, denominator or failure is silently rewritten to suit the repaired implementation. No new exclusion, deferral, rerun, budget reset or threshold is created. Preserve historical failures rather than regrade them as repaired.
reconciliation.historical_evidence: Original corpus/source bytes, questions and gold, case-specific normalization, retained hashes, historical failures and prior attestations remain intact. No frozen content or expectations were rewritten, repurposed or retuned.

reconciliation.history_gap: An agent-mode query referencing relation_events, relation_event_evidence or relation_pairs receives no rows from those tables and the table-level gap relation_history/owner_only. This indicates a caller capability boundary, not existence or counts of hidden records.
reconciliation.implementation_linkage_scope: This reconciliation binds decision 12(a) to exact head 9f3aa77 and the repaired M0039 as requested. It does not issue the separately forthcoming ea-5 implementation-link update or determine the dependent PR #80. ea-4-link-3 binds this branch base; ea-4-link-4 binds PR #79, not a combined head.
reconciliation.lifecycle_and_remaining_authority: State, support eligibility, head, corrections and root status come from the single PR-03 lifecycle projection. Withdrawn assertions remain ineligible support; disputed assertions retain uncertainty. Current/as-of semantics remain consistent across retrieval and inspection. Recursive path support still requires qualified roots. Governed lifecycle writes, relation-assessment activation and the relations inspection reader retain existing owner authority. No archival label or readable row substitutes for a canonical lifecycle decision.
reconciliation.matched_conditions: Both named evaluation peers use the same clarified principal/pairing eligibility, current closure authorization, representations, evidence rules, frame, candidate availability, operations and budgets. No peer receives the earlier broader non-agent access. Whole-family withholding does not create extra evidence or hidden source access.
reconciliation.paired_agent_scope: Without source.raw.read, schema-39 agent mode is limited to an agent principal with a pairing grant. Such a paired agent still needs current memory.query and source.read over every member of the entire disclosed dependency closure for any accepted assessed relation. Pairing alone grants no relation, source, scope or evidence authority. Paired background services, devices and other non-agent callers do not inherit AM-5 access.
reconciliation.raw_boundary: Source-object identities, raw bytes and parts, raw lineage and source revisiting remain owner-only; source.raw.read remains owner-only. Relation readability does not grant raw provenance access. ea-4 retained-unit and exactly pinned all-producer_normalized package-text rules remain applicable and unchanged.
reconciliation.raw_holder_scope: The existing PR-03 raw-read-holder path and its checks remain unchanged. In the shipped role model this is owner authority; this reconciliation grants source.raw.read to nobody and does not reinterpret a deployment-specific raw grant as AM-5 paired-agent permission.
reconciliation.search_and_profile_preservation: AM-5 changes authorized relation-table availability and SQL candidates only within the approved catalog. It does not expand the preregistered authored/source searchable-unit definitions, text/chunking/embedding recipes, ranking/index parameters, model settings or vector preparation rules. No new relation text is silently indexed or embedded.
reconciliation.whole_rows: Authorized agents receive whole catalog rows with the owner values at the same frame, including pinned definitions, rationale, qualification, confidence, task/run/acceptance-receipt references and qualified root status/count where provided by the existing projection. Readability does not infer a new source population, representation, relation judgment or evidence credit.
reconciliation.wire_and_internal_mode: The gaps:[{facet,reason}] shape and catalog columns are unchanged. relation_read_mode remains internal to the sealed frame/population. The new path selects owner or agent only for eligible callers and no agent mode for other callers; no internal mode field or withheld counts are returned.
reconciliation.withheld_relation_dependencies: In agent mode, a relation whose records name any withheld assessed relation is also withheld. This includes replacement-chain and derived_from root-lineage dependencies. Apply whole-family withholding until no remaining disclosed family names a withheld relation. No visible ID, state, replacement row, root status/count, type pin or history may reveal it. This strengthens enforcement of complete closure; it does not infer relations, change the lifecycle projector or create independent-root evidence.
